name: baton
description: Context budget guard and handoff relay: measures real context use per model request, stops subagents that run too long or too big, and hands work over to a fresh session before the main agent drowns.

mainWrapUpPercent.title: Main agent wrap-up at % of compaction window
mainWrapUpPercent.description: Main is told to wrap up and write a handoff past this percent of the auto-compaction window. It also wraps up at 85% of the auto-compaction threshold and at the working-token cap, whichever comes first.

agentMaxPercent.title: Subagent working limit % of compaction window
agentMaxPercent.description: A subagent whose working context (tokens added after its first request) passes this percent of the compaction window, or the working-token cap, is stopped and asked for a handoff.

agentMaxMinutes.title: Subagent time limit (minutes)
agentMaxMinutes.description: A subagent running longer than this is stopped and asked for a handoff of the remaining work.

maxWorkingTokens.title: Working-token cap
maxWorkingTokens.description: Absolute cap on working context above the baseline, for main and subagents alike. Long-context quality degrades with absolute length, not with the fraction of the window.
